profile.headline: Web Developer at Micro Grow Systems
profile.jobTitle: Web Developer/ IT Operator/ AutoCAD Drafter
profile.summary: I'm a developer specializing in website development. As a teen, I became interested in HTML when I was messing around with Myspace and Xanga. Thinking about how much I like HTML, I decided to pursue website development as my career goal. I attended  Mt. San Antonio College where I learned about many programming languages and general IT solutions. As time went on, my passion for technologies and programs grew to the point where I have no doubt that the IT field is for me. Specifically, I really enjoy the creative aspect of the IT field which include web development, graphic design, video editing, and photography. Though I do enjoy the creative aspects, being a web developer as my career goal is much more exciting as it combines IT back-end with front-end designing. I believe as time passes on, I'll keep learning and I'll keep growing to the level I want to achieve in my career.

positions.title: Web Developer/ IT Operator/ AutoCAD Drafter
positions.description: Learn to use AutoCAD and BricsCAD to assist Microgrow with electrical drawings. At the same time, I help manage Microgrow's website and update any information or applications use on the site.

positions.title: Web Developer Internship
positions.description: I was brought into Monster Energy to help with the branding of their digital assets management system. I also learned more about the back-end along with the front-end of the system. I applied my HTML, CSS, and Javascript knowledge along with my SQL and troubleshooting skills to complete the tasks given.

positions.title: IT Administrator and Web Maintenance
positions.description:
As an IT administrator, I make sure I keep all workstations operational and troubleshoot those that aren't. I also  have to make sure systems hardware and wires are intact and update all software when needed. I keep the network connections to Database server stable and make sure everyone is able to connect perfectly. I help to update and edit the website products and webpages. On the creative side, I use Photoshop to edit photos and make fliers for social media and the website. I also take photos of our products behind a white background with photo lights. 

www.amazinggreen.com

positions.title: Store Associate
positions.description: As a part-time associate, I help to refill drinks, food, and other necessities the store needs.  Whenever customers have questions, I help them. I also handle the cashier when a customer is ready to checkout. At the end of the day, I clean up the store by sweeping and mopping the entire store.

positions.title: Seasonal Sales Associate
positions.description: As a sales associate, I handled the back stage, front stage, and theater operations. I learn to use their sales system and helped with screenings and playing music with the magic wand. Along with retail, I learned how their business operations works and the type of computers and technologies they used. I also helped to bring the magic to our guest as a cast member as well.

volunteerExperiences.description: Known for the biggest Anime Convention in North America, Anime Expo is presents Japanese culture and animation as a big event. Anime Expo includes cosplay, panels, screenings, exhibit hall, and much more fun things to do. I helped with ticketed events in sales and helping to fix technical difficulties with our equipment. Though it was subtle, I learn more IT functions for sales business. I volunteered at Anime Expo for 4 years now.

projects.title: Portfolio and Blog
projects.description: A blog about my personal life. My hopes is to learn how to use Wordpress and express my thoughts at the same time, but to also showcase my portfolio of my work.
